propositions: Six src/rebar files sit at or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC hard cap with no other owner, blocking any edit including comments from passing CI.
The module-size limit in .github/module-size-limit.txt is locked and cannot be raised, making file splits the only resolution.
Files must be split along existing logical concerns and architectural call-graph seams, not mechanically, with each resulting file sized 100–500 LOC and leaving real headroom below 720 LOC.
All existing tests for affected areas must pass unmodified after splits; any test change signals the split was not behavior-preserving and must be reconsidered.
_config_sources.py (791 LOC) is now uncovered after its owner (masonic-abeyant-stagbeetle) closed, adding it as an in-scope target alongside the original six files.
